sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Unique-values dropdown: the "Event" column's already-existing "Event info - Event cancelled" section (native `span.cancelled` marker, e.g. `/user/<username>/ratings/event/`'s Event ratings sub-table) now also applies to the `user-ratings-type` page type — `_eventCancelledKind`'s page-type gate extended alongside its existing `tag-value`/`user-tag-value` entries. No new extractor/highlighter — reuses `_findCellEventCancelled()`/`_highlightEventCancelledMatch()` unchanged.
